title: Transfer of Patients between Hospitals Operated by Different Healthcare Groups Without Polyclinic Referral to Maintain Subsidies
what_it_is: Transfer of Patients between Hospitals Operated by Different Healthcare Groups Without Polyclinic Referral to Maintain Subsidies

sections.label: Subsidy retention on transfer
sections.summary: Subsidised patients transferred to another public healthcare institution keep their subsidy status without a polyclinic referral, within or between clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Subsidised patients who are transferred to another public healthcare institution to continue the care for their condition, can retain their subsidy status without the need for a polyclinic referral.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This applies whether within the same cluster or between different clusters.

sections.label: Practice and case details
sections.summary: The practice is followed as far as the speaker is aware, and the Member could be engaged for case details.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As far as I am aware, it is practised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But perhaps I could engage the Member to get some specific details of the case to understand where the gap is and why that was not communicated to the patient.
